Laura (docs): Heads-up — I'm sending a slim refresh PR for the QuickLaunch onboarding tutorial to address an auth mismatch when people follow the Docker flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234
Sam (devex): thanks! quick question — is this the SDK v3 -> v4 migration path or the new SDK6 shortpath?
Laura (docs): it's the SDK v4 shortpath (we kept the function calling example), but the auth env var names were inconsistent with the sample Dockerfile. Found on the local dev smoke test: container fails with 401 after token rotation.
Miguel (eng): can you paste the failing run log?
Laura (docs): sure — minimal repro: 
```
$ docker run --rm -e RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY ghcr.io/redwood/quicklaunch:latest
Error: Unauthorized (401) - missing header X-Redwood-Client or invalid token
```
Sam (devex): ah — that's the old header name. The runtime now accepts Authorization: Bearer <token> and env var RW_API_KEY should be mapped to AUTH_BEARER in the Dockerfile.
Jenna (product): oof — that explains a few support tickets from last quarter. Is this a docs-only change or we need a runtime compat shim?
Miguel (eng): docs-only. We intentionally removed the legacy header last release. We can add a brief note in the migration guide and a small snippet to the Dockerfile.
Laura (docs): proposed patch in the PR updates two places: quicklaunch/tutorial.md and docker/README.md. I also added a compact code example showing the export and run command.
Sam (devex): can you include this snippet? 
```
# set locally then run container
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-live-..."
docker run --rm -e AUTH_BEARER="$REDWOOD_API_KEY" ghcr.io/redwood/quicklaunch:latest
```
Miguel (eng): nah I'd prefer `-e AUTH_BEARER="Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` so the runtime sees the full header value when the entrypoint uses it as-is.
Laura (docs): good call — updated in PR to include the Bearer prefix.
ci-bot: CI triggered for docs/push — link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/12345 (docs lint, linkcheck)
ci-bot: Linkcheck found one broken internal redirect in tutorials/old-quickstart.md -> added to PR as a redirect notice.
Sam (devex): I left a couple of small inline suggestions in the PR for wording and added a quick test plan (how to smoke locally).
Jenna (product): we should also mention this ticket in the release notes: doc fix + migration hint. I'll add a blurb.
Laura (docs): reviewers requested: @Sam (devex), @Miguel (eng) — it's a docs-only change but want the env var naming verified.
Miguel (eng): approving after CI green — just confirm the `Bearer ` prefix is documented clearly.
deploy-bot: staging deploy for website updated (docs-only) — preview at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/5234
Sam (devex): LGTM, a couple of nits fixed.
ci-bot: CI passed :white_check_mark:
Laura (docs): merged — thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open for a quickwatch in case any customers hit edge cases.
Jenna (product): I'll ping support to close related tickets once the site deploys to prod. :thumbsup:
Miguel (eng): thanks — nice quick turnaround.
Laura (docs): closing thread, will follow up if any rollback is needed.
